# Host tree

The host phylogeny places species represented in the first and second EHI data
releases within the wider set of vertebrate hosts recorded by the EHI. Hosts in
the second release are shown at full opacity, species found only in the first
release are translucent, and all remaining EHI hosts are retained as faint,
unlabelled tips.

## Host metadata

Write the host species and taxonomic metadata linked to the current release.

```{r all_host_species, warning=FALSE, comments="", message=FALSE}
host_metadata %>%
  pull(host_species) %>%
  unique() %>%
  sort() %>%
  write_lines(file = str_c("data/", release, "_allhosts.txt"))
```

```{r all_host_species_metadata, warning=FALSE, comments="", message=FALSE}
host_metadata %>%
  write_tsv(file = str_c("data/", release, "_allhosts.tsv"))
```

Combine the current host metadata with the host table archived from the first
data release. `Lepidosauria` in the first-release table is standardised to
`Reptilia` so that the two releases share the same class labels.

```{r combined-host-metadata, warning=FALSE, comments="", message=FALSE}
ehr01_host_metadata <- read_tsv(
  "data/EHR01_host.tsv",
  show_col_types=FALSE
)

ehi_host_species <- read_lines("data/EHI_allhosts.txt") %>%
  str_squish()

tree_name_substitutions <- c(
  "Bombina sp."="Bombina_variegata",
  "Canis familiaris"="Canis_lupus",
  "Psammodromus manuelae"="Psammodromus_hispanicus",
  "Salamandra salamandra gallaica"="Salamandra_salamandra"
)

host_tree_metadata <- bind_rows(
  host_metadata %>% mutate(metadata_priority=1L),
  ehr01_host_metadata %>% mutate(metadata_priority=2L)
) %>%
  arrange(metadata_priority) %>%
  distinct(host_species, .keep_all=TRUE) %>%
  select(-metadata_priority) %>%
  mutate(
    host_class=recode(host_class, "Lepidosauria"="Reptilia"),
    tree_tip=if_else(
      host_species %in% names(tree_name_substitutions),
      unname(tree_name_substitutions[host_species]),
      str_replace_all(host_species, " ", "_")
    ),
    release_status=if_else(
      host_species %in% host_metadata$host_species,
      "Second data release",
      "First data release only"
    ),
    display_label=host_species
  )
```

Four names absent from the TimeTree backbone use explicit taxonomic
substitutions: *Bombina* sp. is placed as *B. variegata*, *Canis familiaris*
as *C. lupus*, *Psammodromus manuelae* as *P. hispanicus*, and *Salamandra
salamandra gallaica* as *S. salamandra*.

## Combined time-calibrated phylogeny

The phylogenetic backbone is the time-calibrated tetrapod tree from TimeTree
[@kumar2022timetree], pruned to all resolvable EHI vertebrate hosts. This
retains the broad EHI context used in the first data release while adding all
hosts represented in EHR02.

```{r all_host_tree, warning=FALSE, comments="", message=FALSE}
host_tree_path <- "data/EHI_EHR01_EHR02_allhosts.nwk"

if (!file.exists(host_tree_path)) {
  stop("Combined EHI host tree not found: ", host_tree_path)
}

all_host_tree <- read_tree(host_tree_path)

unmatched_tree_hosts <- host_tree_metadata %>%
  filter(!tree_tip %in% all_host_tree$tip.label)

if (nrow(unmatched_tree_hosts) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Hosts missing from the combined tree: ",
    paste(unmatched_tree_hosts$host_species, collapse=", ")
  )
}
```

The archived EHI host catalogue contains `r n_distinct(ehi_host_species)`
names, of which `r Ntip(all_host_tree)` resolve as distinct tips in the
phylogenetic backbone. Only the `r nrow(host_tree_metadata)` hosts represented
in EHR01 or EHR02 are labelled. Branches are coloured by vertebrate class when
all descendant tips belong to the same class; deeper branches spanning
multiple classes are shown in dark grey.

```{r host-tree, fig.cap="Time-calibrated phylogeny of vertebrate hosts represented by the EHI. EHR02 hosts are shown at full opacity, hosts found only in EHR01 are translucent, and other EHI hosts are faint, unlabelled tips. Branch colours indicate vertebrate class.", fig.width=20, fig.height=6, out.width="100%", dpi=300, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
descendant_tips <- function(representative_tips) {
  clade_node <- getMRCA(all_host_tree, representative_tips)
  extract.clade(all_host_tree, clade_node)$tip.label
}

amphibian_tips <- descendant_tips(
  c("Bombina_variegata", "Salamandra_atra", "Ptychohyla_hypomykter")
)

mammal_tips <- descendant_tips(
  c("Ornithorhynchus_anatinus", "Vombatus_ursinus", "Mus_musculus")
)

bird_tips <- descendant_tips(
  c("Psittacula_echo", "Strix_aluco", "Zonotrichia_capensis")
)

tip_metadata <- tibble(
  tree_tip=all_host_tree$tip.label,
  node=seq_len(Ntip(all_host_tree))
) %>%
  mutate(
    host_class=case_when(
      tree_tip %in% amphibian_tips ~ "Amphibia",
      tree_tip %in% mammal_tips ~ "Mammalia",
      tree_tip %in% bird_tips ~ "Aves",
      TRUE ~ "Reptilia"
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    host_tree_metadata %>%
      select(tree_tip, release_status, display_label),
    by="tree_tip"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    release_status=replace_na(release_status, "Other EHI host"),
    display_label=if_else(
      release_status == "Other EHI host",
      NA_character_,
      display_label
    )
  )

internal_node_metadata <- map_dfr(
  seq.int(Ntip(all_host_tree) + 1L, Ntip(all_host_tree) + all_host_tree$Nnode),
  function(node_id) {
    descendant_tips <- extract.clade(all_host_tree, node_id)$tip.label
    descendant_metadata <- tip_metadata %>%
      filter(tree_tip %in% descendant_tips)

    tibble(
      node=node_id,
      host_class=if (
        n_distinct(descendant_metadata$host_class) == 1L
      ) descendant_metadata$host_class[[1]] else "Mixed",
      release_status=case_when(
        any(descendant_metadata$release_status == "Second data release") ~
          "Second data release",
        any(descendant_metadata$release_status == "First data release only") ~
          "First data release only",
        TRUE ~ "Other EHI host"
      ),
      display_label=NA_character_
    )
  }
)

tree_node_metadata <- bind_rows(
  tip_metadata %>%
    select(node, host_class, release_status, display_label),
  internal_node_metadata
)

host_class_colours <- c(
  "Amphibia"="#24BFC4",
  "Mammalia"="#B64D86",
  "Reptilia"="#62BE4B",
  "Aves"="#B39A2E",
  "Mixed"="#3F4448"
)

release_alpha <- c(
  "Second data release"=1,
  "First data release only"=0.30,
  "Other EHI host"=0.12
)

tip_sizes <- c(
  "Second data release"=2.2,
  "First data release only"=1.7,
  "Other EHI host"=0.55
)

host_tree_plot <- ggtree(all_host_tree) %<+%
  tree_node_metadata +
  aes(colour=host_class, alpha=release_status) +
  geom_tippoint(aes(size=release_status)) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    name="Vertebrate class",
    values=host_class_colours,
    breaks=c("Amphibia", "Mammalia", "Reptilia", "Aves", "Mixed")
  ) +
  scale_alpha_manual(
    name="Release coverage",
    values=release_alpha,
    breaks=c(
      "Second data release",
      "First data release only",
      "Other EHI host"
    )
  ) +
  scale_size_manual(
    values=tip_sizes,
    guide="none"
  )

tip_y_range <- range(host_tree_plot$data$y[host_tree_plot$data$isTip])
minimum_label_gap <- 4.5

spread_overlapping_labels <- function(y, lower, upper, minimum_gap) {
  label_index <- seq_along(y) - 1
  transformed_y <- y - label_index * minimum_gap
  fitted_y <- stats::isoreg(transformed_y)$yf
  fitted_y <- pmin(
    pmax(fitted_y, lower),
    upper - max(label_index) * minimum_gap
  )
  fitted_y + label_index * minimum_gap
}

release_tip_labels <- host_tree_plot$data %>%
  filter(isTip, !is.na(display_label)) %>%
  arrange(y) %>%
  mutate(
    label_y=spread_overlapping_labels(
      y=y,
      lower=tip_y_range[[1]],
      upper=tip_y_range[[2]],
      minimum_gap=minimum_label_gap
    )
  )

tree_age <- max(host_tree_plot$data$x, na.rm=TRUE)

host_tree_plot$data <- host_tree_plot$data %>%
  mutate(
    x=tree_age - x,
    branch=tree_age - branch
  )

host_tree_plot <- host_tree_plot +
  geom_segment(
    data=release_tip_labels,
    aes(
      x=0,
      y=y,
      xend=-70,
      yend=label_y,
      colour=host_class,
      alpha=release_status
    ),
    linewidth=0.28,
    inherit.aes=FALSE,
    show.legend=FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data=release_tip_labels,
    aes(
      x=-80,
      y=label_y,
      label=display_label,
      colour=host_class,
      alpha=release_status
    ),
    angle=90,
    hjust=1,
    size=2.7,
    fontface="italic",
    inherit.aes=FALSE,
    show.legend=FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name="Millions of years ago",
    breaks=seq(0, 350, by=50),
    limits=c(-350, ceiling(tree_age / 10) * 10),
    expand=expansion(mult=c(0, 0.01))
  ) +
  coord_flip(clip="off") +
  theme_tree2() +
  theme(
    legend.position="right",
    legend.title=element_text(size=10),
    legend.text=element_text(size=9),
    axis.title.y=element_text(size=10),
    axis.text.y=element_text(size=9),
    axis.title.x=element_blank(),
    axis.text.x=element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
    axis.line.x=element_blank(),
    plot.margin=margin(8, 12, 8, 8)
  )

ggsave(
  filename=file.path("figure", str_c(release, "_host_tree.svg")),
  plot=host_tree_plot,
  width=20,
  height=6,
  units="in",
  device=svglite::svglite
)

ggsave(
  filename=file.path("figure", str_c(release, "_host_tree.pdf")),
  plot=host_tree_plot,
  width=20,
  height=6,
  units="in",
  device=grDevices::cairo_pdf
)

host_tree_plot
